@kazweida @allen_westray Dear Dr. Blasey Ford,

Know that whatever you decide to do in regards to the Brett Kavanaugh hearing, we support you unequivocally. 

And if you decide to testify, know that you will not be alone. An army of survivors stand with you. 

In love & gratitude,
An American
